title: HMAC key preparation accepts asymmetric public keys as HMAC secrets, enabling algorithm confusion
source: Real-world defect (reconstruction): PyJWT HMACAlgorithm.prepare_key pre-fix logic for CVE-2022-29217 (GHSA-ffqj-6fqr-9h24; asymmetric public keys usable as HMAC secrets), fixed upstream by PyJWT commit 9c528670c455b8d948aff95ed50e22940d1ad3fc (released in 2.4.0); the defective function is reconstructed standalone in this case, 2026-11-05
